# Smart Device Platform — Agent Guide

Short entry point for coding agents. Use this file for start-up discipline only; detailed rules live in [`harness/`](harness/), project navigation lives in [`docs/INDEX.md`](docs/INDEX.md).

## Project Overview

Flutter monorepo for smart-device Apps such as glasses, watches, and earphones. App-specific behavior
stays in Apps. Shared capabilities enter Foundation only when they meet the ownership and Spec
admission rules; qualifying contracts precede Foundation implementation.

```text
apps/              App shells, brand and App-specific logic
packages/widget/   Reusable or cross-Feature UI composition outside an owning Feature
packages/feature/  Complete user scenarios, grouped by domain (device/, ai/, …)
packages/common/   Shared primitives below Feature (no Feature deps)
packages/core/     Platform-neutral base types and reusable capability contracts
packages/platform/ Native SDK artifacts, bridges and platform lifecycle adapters
specs/             Capability contracts
```

Dependencies use only permitted public APIs. Apps may depend directly on any lower layer; Widget,
Feature, and Common boundaries follow
[`docs/architecture.md`](docs/architecture.md#layer-structure). A Feature may consume another
Feature's public contract only through a single-direction, cycle-free dependency under
[`ADR-0010`](docs/decisions/0010-feature-dependencies.md). Core and Platform are peer Foundation
partitions; they may consume each other's public APIs when ownership requires it, while their
combined package graph remains acyclic under
[`ADR-0011`](docs/decisions/0011-platform-device-runtime.md).

## Fact Priority

Use each source for the fact it owns:

- Code and `pubspec.yaml` describe current implementation and dependencies. Passing tests provide
  evidence only for the behavior they exercise.
- `stable` Specs define adopted public capability contracts.
- `active` Specs define evolving contracts under adoption; they do not prove delivery.
- Accepted ADRs define architecture decisions and require a superseding ADR to change. Current
  architecture documents describe the adopted model and must remain consistent with them.
- Device, platform, SDK, backend, parity, and runtime claims require traceable runtime evidence.
- Draft Specs, Plans, and `app_configs/` describe intent only.

When sources disagree about the same fact, use status, chronology, and explicit supersession to
resolve them. Follow [`docs/INDEX.md`](docs/INDEX.md#fact-priority) and report unresolved material
conflicts instead of silently selecting a convenient source.

`app_configs/` remains planning input for existing Apps and does not participate in their manual
builds. `tool/app_assembly.dart` is the implemented generator/validator for explicitly admitted v1
configs; it does not replace the checked-in `apps/` shells or make `generate_app.dart` a capability.

## Independent Judgment

* Before accepting a request's premise or proposed solution, check for false assumptions, logical
  gaps, missing context, and unsupported conclusions.
* Distinguish verified facts, evidence-based inferences, uncertain assumptions, and subjective
  judgments. Verify material figures, entities, and conclusions against traceable sources when
  relevant and practical.
* Do not optimize for agreement. When evidence contradicts the proposed direction, state the
  disagreement directly and explain the basis, risks, overlooked variables, costs, biases, and
  credible alternatives.
* Do not expand the task merely to eliminate every uncertainty. Surface material uncertainty and
  ask or investigate further only when it could meaningfully change the implementation or outcome.

# platform_device_runtime — Agent Guide

Self-contained entry point for coding agents working inside
`platform_device_runtime`. This is a router; the full map — Fact Priority,
Path Map, and the longer Navigation-by-Task table — lives in
[`docs/INDEX.md`](docs/INDEX.md). Hard rules and the Doc Sync Matrix live in
[`harness/rules.md`](harness/rules.md). Consult the monorepo root
[`AGENTS.md`](../../../AGENTS.md) only for cross-package concerns not covered
by either of the above (Git/PR policy, workspace-wide layering).

## What This Package Is

The single Android/iOS native device runtime plugin: private Pigeon bridge, one VK BLE SDK session, raw byte transport, and the identity / settings / network-session / network-settings / file-transfer clients built on top of it. Foundation partition: `packages/platform/` — native SDK artifacts, generated bridges and platform lifecycle adapters live here; platform-neutral contracts and base capabilities remain in Core. Why this package stays one runtime rather than one plugin per capability is [ADR-0007](../../../docs/decisions/0007-single-device-native-runtime.md); its Platform relocation is [ADR-0011](../../../docs/decisions/0011-platform-device-runtime.md). Only stable typed contracts are exported from `lib/platform_device_runtime.dart`; Feature, Common and App code must never import generated bridge types or vendor SDK types directly (see `README.md`).

This package is expected to keep growing: both platforms split SDK adapters by
capability domain. Treat new vendor SDKs, device categories, or capability
domains as additive — keep the existing module boundaries rather than
inventing a new shape per feature.

## Engineering Rules

Hard constraints, boundaries, and the Doc Sync Matrix for this package live in
[`harness/rules.md`](harness/rules.md) — kept local so this plugin does not
depend on the monorepo root harness for everyday rules.

## Fact Priority

When conflicts arise, follow the authority order in
[`docs/INDEX.md`](docs/INDEX.md#fact-priority): this package's own export
surface and bridge contract first, then its own docs and rules, then the
decision/plan record for its shape, then adopted specs and vendor protocol
reference, then the monorepo root as a last resort.

## Module Map (`lib/src/`)

Most capability domains follow the `model/ | service/ | impl/ | provider/` split: `service/`
defines the public contract, `impl/` is the Pigeon-backed implementation, and `provider/` is the
Riverpod injection point. `runtime/` is the composition root, `file_transfer/` additionally owns
media-import controllers and music-transfer clients, and `find_phone/` owns the typed Pigeon client plus
the Android/iOS source-SDK adapters and App-scoped alert effect contract.

| Domain | Responsibility | Native counterpart (Android) |
|---|---|---|
| `transport/` | Scan/connect/raw BLE transport, exposed as `core_ble`'s `BleService` | `PlatformDeviceNativeRuntimePlugin` |
| `notification/` | Android SDK 系统通知监听、当前连接自动投递与私有 bridge；真机显示仍待验证 | `PlatformDeviceNativeRuntimePlugin`, `AndroidNotificationListenerRecovery` |
| `runtime/` | Shared Runtime lifecycle plus Glasses/Watch composition roots | — |
| `identity/` | Device identity/code binding write-back | `PlatformDeviceIdentityPlugin` |
| `settings/` | Generic device settings get/set | `PlatformDeviceSettingsPlugin` |
| `network/` | AP/P2P/station network session; the only entry point for a stable host endpoint | `PlatformDeviceNetworkSessionPlugin` |
| `network_settings/` | Home Wi-Fi scan/connect/credentials | `PlatformDeviceNetworkSettingsPlugin` |
| `file_transfer/` | Media import plus device music listing/transfer | `PlatformDeviceFileTransferPlugin`, `PlatformDeviceMusicPlugin` |
| `ota_transfer/` | Firmware OTA transfer/progress | `PlatformDeviceOtaTransferPlugin` |
| `camera_preview/` | BK H264 preview texture, lifecycle and PNG capture | `PlatformDeviceCameraPreviewPlugin` |
| `capabilities/` | Read-only per-operation support snapshot for the connected device | `PlatformDeviceCapabilitiesPlugin` |
| `audio_bluetooth/` | AKW/BK classic audio Bluetooth query/connect/observe and settings fallback | `PlatformDeviceAudioBluetoothPlugin` |
| `app_llm/` | Current-session typed App LLM device events and collaboration commands | `PlatformDeviceAppLlmPlugin` |
| `interpretation/` | Current-session typed simultaneous-interpretation events and collaboration commands | `PlatformDeviceInterpretationPlugin` |
| `wearing_state/` | Current-session typed wearing-state observation | `PlatformDeviceWearingStatePlugin` |
| `call_recording/` | Session-scoped typed call-recording command and authoritative business state | `PlatformDeviceCallRecordingPlugin` |
| `call_translation/` | 通话直译 target/session/operation、字幕与状态的内部候选合同；未从公共 barrel 导出，默认 typed unsupported | 尚未装配，见 Plan 0183 与 SDK-058 |
| `account_health/` | Account-scoped health evidence synchronization | `PlatformDeviceAccountHealthPlugin` |
| `schedule/` | Session-scoped schedule commands and observation | `PlatformDeviceSchedulePlugin` |
| `media_control/` | Session-scoped media playback controls | `PlatformDeviceMediaControlPlugin` |
| `media_processing/` | Local media composition contract; Glasses profile has FFmpeg-backed adapter, other profiles remain typed unsupported pending device evidence | `PlatformDeviceMediaProcessingPlugin` |
| `remote_camera/` | Remote camera commands and observation | `PlatformDeviceRemoteCameraPlugin` |
| `pairing/` | SDK device unbind plus explicit platform system-pairing cleanup | `PlatformDevicePairingPlugin` |
| `watch_face/` | Market watch-face local-file install/progress/cancellation | `PlatformDeviceWatchFaceInstallPlugin` |
| `health/` | Session-scoped typed health record synchronization | `PlatformDeviceHealthEvidencePlugin` |
| `find_phone/` | Session-scoped device intent, business state and App-scoped phone alert contract | `PlatformDeviceFindPhonePlugin` |
| `wechat_reply/` | Watch-only SDK 微信登录、验证、回复会话与安全账号存储 | `PlatformDeviceWechatReplyPlugin` |
| `pay_code/` | Unified session-scoped PayCode lifecycle; Android SDK selects its runtime, while iOS returns typed unsupported until a unified SDK runtime is delivered | `PlatformDevicePayCodePlugin` |

Native platform code mirrors capability bridge ownership rather than the Dart folder layout 1:1.
In particular, Dart `file_transfer/` fronts both file-transfer and music Plugins on Android/iOS;
`runtime/` is the composition root, while `find_phone/` uses the SDK typed session stream and a
platform-native App alert owner. The default capability remains unavailable while the current SDK
snapshot reports `Unknown`; source integration is development evidence, not a production support claim.
A new capability domain should follow the closest existing ownership shape instead of assuming every
folder requires exactly one native Plugin.

## Native Platform Constraints

- The root [`SDK/`](../../../SDK/index.md) directory keeps SDK rules, protocol ownership,
  upgrade requests and historical release evidence. The repository does not retain local
  Android/iOS SDK binaries; do not restore them as build inputs.
- Android: VK modules resolve from the internal Maven repository using published POM
  coordinates. Every consuming App/example root must expose the same repository because
  Flutter plugin dependencies are resolved in the consumer build.
- iOS: the runtime Pod target owns the selected VK Pods resolved from the internal Specs
  repository. Do not restore local XCFramework links or the removed WeiKe source-vendoring
  path; the iOS 1.8.3 physical-device capability matrix remains tracked by Plan 0048.
  If a future source delivery needs a vendor fix, put it in a dedicated file
  under `VendorPatches/` with a comment naming the upstream issue.
- Both platforms: App-level Podfiles/Gradle files must not add a second VK BLE Core/AKW/BK owner — this plugin is the only runtime that vendors them. The development-only source substitution defined by [`SDK/rules.md`](../../../SDK/rules.md#android--ios-本地源码联调) may select local source for the same dependencies; it must stay disabled for CI, test distribution, and release.

## Pigeon Bridge

Adapter shape, error mapping, cancellation/lifecycle, and binary-data rules for any Pigeon bridge in this workspace are defined once in [`native_bridge`](../../../specs/cross-cutting/native_bridge.md) — do not re-derive them here.

`pigeons/<domain>_bridge.dart` — one private Pigeon schema per capability domain — is the source of truth for that domain's HostApi/FlutterApi contract. Regenerate all of them together from the repository root after any change:

```sh
tool/generate_device_native_runtime_bridges.sh
```

This regenerates every `lib/src/generated/<domain>_bridge.g.dart`, the matching Kotlin `generated/<Domain>Bridge.g.kt` and Swift `Generated/<Domain>Bridge.g.swift` together — never hand-edit any of the generated outputs. Each schema uses its own `fileSpecificClassNameComponent` so generated error classes and DTOs stay distinct across domains even though they compile into the same native module; HostApi/FlutterApi names and channel methods are unchanged from before the split. Generated types stay private to each domain's `impl/` class; `service/` contracts expose only hand-written Dart types.

## Task Navigation

| Task | Start with |
|---|---|
| Add a new native capability domain | Module map above → add `HostApi`/`FlutterApi` in the pigeon file → implement one `Plugin` class per platform → add `model/service/impl/provider` under `lib/src/<domain>/` (spec-first if it changes an adopted contract — see Fact Priority) |
| Change an existing capability's public contract/behavior | The owning spec under [`specs/capabilities/`](../../../specs/capabilities/) first, then the matching `service/`/`impl/` |
| Change an existing bridge method/message | Edit the owning `pigeons/<domain>_bridge.dart` → regenerate → update the matching `impl/` class on both platforms |
| BLE connect/scan/session/raw-transport bug | `transport/` + `PlatformDeviceNativeRuntimePlugin.kt` / the iOS transport plugin, then [`harness/pitfalls.md#ble`](../../../harness/pitfalls.md) (root, shared knowledge) |
| Glasses protocol byte-level detail | [`specs/capabilities/glasses_protocol.md`](../../../specs/capabilities/glasses_protocol.md), [`docs/glasses-ble-dev-guide.md`](../../../docs/glasses-ble-dev-guide.md) |
| Select/upgrade a vendor SDK artifact or version | [`SDK/rules.md`](../../../SDK/rules.md) → [`SDK/index.md`](../../../SDK/index.md); file a gap via [`SDK/upgrade-requests.md`](../../../SDK/upgrade-requests.md) if the SDK team owns it |
| Change Runtime Profile identifiers, source sets, or artifact assembly | [`harness/rules.md`](harness/rules.md#runtime-profile-assembly) |

## Testing

`test/` mirrors `lib/src/` by domain (`file_transfer/`, `identity/`, `network/`, `network_settings/`, `ota_transfer/`, `settings/`, `transport/`, `watch_face/`). Add tests under the matching domain folder; fake the Pigeon `HostApi` rather than exercising a real device or vendor SDK.

```sh
tool/verify.sh package packages/platform/platform_device_runtime
```

## 报错在说什么

```
Direct local .aar file dependencies are not supported when building an AAR
... :vk-media-processing ... libs/stabilizer-sdk-release.aar
```

这是 AGP 的 `hasLocalAarDeps` 限制：**一个自身要产出 AAR 的 library 模块，不能用 `files(*.aar)`/`fileTree(*.aar)` 这种直接本地文件依赖**——因为本地 AAR 的 classes/资源不会被写进产物、也不会进 POM，产出的 AAR 会是坏的。所以我上一轮把它改回 `files('libs/...')` 是错的；`c436678c` 改成坐标方向是对的，只是坐标落到了只在你机器 `~/.m2` 的地方。

**① SDK 仓库** `newblesdk/android/sdk/vk-media-processing/build.gradle`

-    implementation 'com.vk.local:stabilizer-sdk:1.0.0'
+    implementation(name: 'stabilizer-sdk-release', ext: 'aar')
```

只改 ① 时 `:vk-media-processing:bundleDebugAar` 能过，但完整 app 会失败：
```
Could not find :stabilizer-sdk-release:. Required by project ':app' > :platform_device_runtime > :vk-media-processing

```kotlin
val mediaProcessingLibs = sdkBuild.resolve("vk-media-processing/libs")
if (mediaProcessingLibs.isDirectory) {
    gradle.beforeProject {
        repositories { flatDir { dirs(mediaProcessingLibs.absolutePath) } }
    }
}
```

## 和原生对照（问题所在）

两个原生实现都是 **循环读多组** 的，协议本身支持多组 `[chipLen][chip][verLen][version]`：

- Android `OtherAnalyzer.handlerDeviceKernelVersion`（:563）：`while (offset < bytes.size)`，把每组 `frameworkVersion` 收进 `versionList`，`DeviceInfoActivity` 用 `\n` 逐行展示 **全部** 版本。
- iOS `BLE_WAKEUP+DeviceInfo.m ble_receiveDeviceFrameworkVersion`（:48）：`while (offset < totalLength)`，每组生成 `WKBLEDeviceFrameworkVersion{chipType, version}`，`WKDeviceInfoProvider` 展示 `version` 列表。

SDK 只解析第一组并丢掉其余：
- 设备报多组时，Flutter/SDK 只显示第一组的 chip+version，**可能是错的型号/版本**；
- 原生 UI 显示的是“版本列表”（不含 chipType），Flutter 却拼了 `chipType version`；
- `kernelChipType`/`kernelFrameworkVersion` 是单值合同，本身表达不了多组。

另外两个小的不对齐：
- iOS 要求 `bytes.count > 7`（≥8），Android 是 `size < 7`（≥7），两端边界不一致；
- 解析只校验 `packet[4] == 0x92` / 子命令 `0x01`，没校验 `packet[3] == 0xFF`；且 `0x92/0x01` 这条解析**没有任何单测**（`VKPacketEventParserTest` 里没有 kernel 用例）。

Only stable typed contracts are exported from `lib/platform_device_runtime.dart`; Feature, Common and App code must never import generated bridge types or vendor SDK types directly (see `README.md`).

This package is expected to keep growing: both platforms split SDK adapters by
capability domain. Treat new vendor SDKs, device categories, or capability
domains as additive — keep the existing module boundaries rather than
inventing a new shape per feature.

## Engineering Rules

Hard constraints, boundaries, and the Doc Sync Matrix for this package live in
[`harness/rules.md`](harness/rules.md) — kept local so this plugin does not
depend on the monorepo root harness for everyday rules.

## Native Platform Constraints

- The root [`SDK/`](../../../SDK/index.md) directory keeps SDK rules, protocol ownership,
  upgrade requests and historical release evidence. The repository does not retain local
  Android/iOS SDK binaries; do not restore them as build inputs.
- Android: VK modules resolve from the internal Maven repository using published POM
  coordinates. Every consuming App/example root must expose the same repository because
  Flutter plugin dependencies are resolved in the consumer build.
- iOS: the runtime Pod target owns the selected VK Pods resolved from the internal Specs
  repository. Do not restore local XCFramework links or the removed WeiKe source-vendoring
  path; the iOS 1.8.3 physical-device capability matrix remains tracked by Plan 0048.
  If a future source delivery needs a vendor fix, put it in a dedicated file
  under `VendorPatches/` with a comment naming the upstream issue.
- Both platforms: App-level Podfiles/Gradle files must not add a second VK BLE Core/AKW/BK owner — this plugin is the only runtime that vendors them. The development-only source substitution defined by [`SDK/rules.md`](../../../SDK/rules.md#android--ios-本地源码联调) may select local source for the same dependencies; it must stay disabled for CI, test distribution, and release.

## Pigeon Bridge

Adapter shape, error mapping, cancellation/lifecycle, and binary-data rules for any Pigeon bridge in this workspace are defined once in [`native_bridge`](../../../specs/cross-cutting/native_bridge.md) — do not re-derive them here.

`pigeons/<domain>_bridge.dart` — one private Pigeon schema per capability domain — is the source of truth for that domain's HostApi/FlutterApi contract. Regenerate all of them together from the repository root after any change:

```sh
tool/generate_device_native_runtime_bridges.sh
```

This regenerates every `lib/src/generated/<domain>_bridge.g.dart`, the matching Kotlin `generated/<Domain>Bridge.g.kt` and Swift `Generated/<Domain>Bridge.g.swift` together — never hand-edit any of the generated outputs. Each schema uses its own `fileSpecificClassNameComponent` so generated error classes and DTOs stay distinct across domains even though they compile into the same native module; HostApi/FlutterApi names and channel methods are unchanged from before the split. Generated types stay private to each domain's `impl/` class; `service/` contracts expose only hand-written Dart types.

## 根因：正式 ipa 的 archive strip 删掉了 Agora 的 FFI 入口符号

`agora_rtc_engine` 6.6.4 在 iOS 上通过 **`dart:ffi`** 解析原生入口：
`lib/src/impl/platform/io/native_iris_api_engine_binding_delegate.dart`
```dart
ffi.DynamicLibrary _loadLib() { ... return ffi.DynamicLibrary.process(); }
```
然后用 `dlsym(RTLD_DEFAULT, "CreateIrisApiEngine"/"CallIrisApi"/...)` 取符号。实时通讯功能注册 `AudioFrameObserver`（`realtime_communication_controller.dart:1469`）正走这条 FFI 链路。

- **Debug / `flutter run`**：不做 archive，不跑 strip 阶段 → 符号在 → 正常。
- **`flutter build ipa`（正式包/TestFlight/App Store）**：archive 阶段启用 `DEPLOYMENT_POSTPROCESSING`，而 Runner 目标默认 `STRIP_STYLE = all`，会把可执行文件里的全局符号整体删掉 → 运行时 `symbol lookup` 失败 → 实时通讯初始化/入会失败。

这与“debug 可以、正式线不行”的形态完全一致。证据链：
- Agora 官方插件 README 的 **“iOS not work on release mode”** 专节；
- Agora 维护者在 [Agora-Flutter-SDK#1437](https://github.com/AgoraIO-Extensions/Agora-Flutter-SDK/issues/1437) 明确指向 Flutter 的 “Stripping iOS symbols”；
- 声网官方 FAQ《[如何解决 Flutter 上 iOS release 包初始化时报 symbol not found 的问题？](https://doc.shengwang.cn/faq/integration-issues/flutter-ios-build)》：**Strip Style → Non-Global Symbols**；
- 同类修复 PR [flet#6813](https://github.com/flet-dev/flet/pull/6813)：Runner 的 Release/Profile 由默认 `all` 改为 `non-global`，明确写了 “只出现在 `.ipa`：`flutter run --release` 不 strip，所以开发机正常、TestFlight/App Store 失败”。
